title: Trump Wanted Canada as the 51st State. He Ended Up Pushing It Toward the European Union.
summary: The invitation by the E.U. for Canada to become an “associate member” is a sign of Mr. Trump’s brand of diplomacy, which often involves threatening America’s closest friends.
